datasheet_identity.title: SD103AW THRU SD103CW Surface Mount Schottky Barrier Rectifier

extraction_notes: The supplied PDF publishes SD103AW, SD103BW, and SD103CW together; SD103AW uses VRRM = 40 V and the 30 V reverse-current test row.
The three curves contain real plotted points digitized from the Ta = 25 degC traces only; no intermediate values were synthesized by interpolation.
Curve values were converted from the plotted mV, mA, microA, and pF axes to V, A, and F SI units.
The forward-voltage table entries are maximum values, while the reverse-current row is a maximum and the capacitance and reverse-recovery entries are typical characteristic values.
Schottky polarity is anode to cathode in the forward direction; the reverse curve is plotted as positive reverse voltage and positive reverse-current magnitude.
